description: This file contains a constant-time implementation of GHASH used in GCM mode encryption, including functions for multiplication in GF(2^128), GHASH initialization, and processing data blocks, with support for different hardware acceleration options.

methods.name: gcm_mul64_nohw
methods.description: Performs 64-bit multiplication in GF(2^128) without hardware acceleration, using different implementations based on available CPU features.

methods.name: gcm_mul32_nohw
methods.description: Performs 32-bit multiplication in GF(2^128) as part of the 64-bit multiplication process.

methods.name: gcm_init_nohw
methods.description: Initializes the GHASH subkey table in a constant-time manner, supporting different hardware capabilities.

methods.name: gcm_polyval_nohw
methods.description: Performs polynomial multiplication and reduction in GF(2^128) for GHASH, supporting different hardware capabilities.
